basis: Coordinator synthesis after full-description comparative review of 25 candidates and targeted read-only inspection of existing source snapshots. No new execution or video viewing. Scores are provisional analyst judgments, not probabilities.
datePolicy: No date penalties. User reports a 12-hour extension; no exact new cutoff inferred.

projects.reason: Retains the strongest overall case: a shared validation engine, actionable repairs, context lifetimes and grading/yarn computation support more than a scripted assistant. Concrete reported native recovery is unusually persuasive. Broader garment correctness and designer adoption remain unverified; spoken charts are future work.

New leading contender. Shared pointing, priced domain actions, settlement evidence and precise Chrome/ChatGPT interoperability repairs justify exceptional leverage and strong execution. Consumer demand and publisher economics are less established, so impact is lower. Mainnet purchase evidence and the testnet onboarding path are distinct, and browser-held wallet keys limit practical custody.

New leading contender. Pending calls plus human edits expose a real shared-state race; replay, fresh-state reduction and exported regressions form a coherent developer workflow. Three adapters and an upstream-linked Plane model give concrete transfer potential. The model and proposed patch are not an upstream-accepted fix or validated live deployment; adopters must supply application-specific actions and invariants.

Promoted from conditional alternate on technical merit. Human constraints change optimization, revisions invalidate results, and the inspected verifier reapplies changes and recomputes routing rather than trusting solver status. Verification holds within a bounded network model, not protocol convergence or production safety. Large adaptive generation can take tens of seconds. The Vimeo-only collected embed remains a separate unresolved YouTube-material caveat, not a numeric penalty.

New leading contender. Body-specific clearance questions, durable disputes and narrowly applied server mutations provide a distinctive accessibility workflow. UNKNOWN measurements stay unknown and renames cannot carry unrelated geometry changes. Model coherence does not verify the real building; venue accounts, multi-floor routing and operational adoption remain incomplete.

Promoted from the old shortlist. It identifies where a mobility-sized route stops, reports resolved and introduced findings, and describes specific measurement/lifecycle defects and fixes. The 50 mm raster, circular body and simplified standards limit practical conclusions. Approval is configurable, and matching printed area does not prove accurate topology or doorway dimensions.

Remains competitive after recalibration. Shared executable claims, deterministic routines, exact-byte receipts and explicit missingness create a distinctive scientific document. Primary-source checks are absent, dependent records lack covariance modeling, and the wider research lifecycle is not integrated. The prior click timeout remains inconclusive rather than proof the scientific routines fail; impact is reduced to reflect these substantive limits.

Retained for a particularly coherent bounded observing workflow: astronomy-engine, contextual tools, location-specific revalidation and reported native invocation across the surface. The source supports careful in-flight lifecycle handling. Catalog/weather limits and absent observer trials constrain impact; reported integration tests are not independent ephemeris validation.

Retained because operating on unsaved cells, current selection and the actual notebook kernel is directly useful. The inspected source-hash guard makes stale-write protection concrete. Its description provides less specific validation than the execution leaders; proposed edits cover updates, not every operation, and visible-cell execution is not a general sandbox. Existing Jupyter maturity is not all new challenge work.

Retained at the boundary for its distinctive two-device remote-assistance workflow, separate device/control identity, receipts and marker suppression. Tracking robustness is not characterized sufficiently for a higher execution estimate, and TURN plus durable multi-instance state are future work. No camera or two-device test was performed here. Model-visible camera information has a different privacy boundary from the server's no-recording claim.

Still a close alternate, but broader comparison reduces its original top-ten confidence. Tombstones, commit-time checks, recovery and honest indeterminate states are substantial. The inspected router uses deterministic intent/keyword/context scoring; the large synthetic catalog is not proof of general routing or third-party adoption. Page approval tokens do not authenticate a human identity.

A strong new alternate with unusually original interaction: human pointing defines authority, the agent builds and repairs a plan, and handler checks reinforce scoped schemas. The seeded dispatch exercise reduces late deliveries from six to one, not zero; it does not demonstrate general route optimization, server-backed multi-user authorization or independent production adoption.

Moves to alternate, not because of a discovered failure. Preview/commit, provenance, undo, typed authoring and export gating are substantial, while unsupported spirals are refused explicitly. The deterministic kernel and reported OpenRoads round-trip predate the extension. Illustrative criteria and conceptual-design scope limit current application; license-qualified review cannot be inferred from a UI confirmation.

Moves to alternate under wider comparison. Shared scoring, sounding/written pitch separation, locked bars and human A/B auditions address useful arranging work, and reported transposition defects show concrete iteration. Some tests use a stand-in host; engraving, sound quality and teacher utility remain unverified, and MusicXML import is future work.

Moves to alternate while remaining a distinctive diagnostic product. Hidden fault state, human measurements and evidence-linked repair staging create a useful separation of responsibilities. The delivered scope is a virtual exercise; broader faults, measured learning outcomes and physical-instrument transfer remain unestablished. Prior page loading was not a completed diagnostic run.

Moves to alternate after the coordinator reread the full description. Contextual wall editing, SAT constraints, reported repair from an invented ID, dimensional mismatch detection and production-header debugging are concrete strengths. The partner uses postMessage where native discovery is absent, image tracing needs dual uploads and explicit scale, and IFC export/multi-floor work are future. A static local app can still send geometry or images to an external model; the reported clean constraint result does not prove plan fidelity.

Strong adoption-oriented alternate: resolved OpenAPI feeds the live Swagger request pipeline and shared call-time policy applies to direct, generic and batch paths. It is a skillful reusable integration, not unprecedented authority design. Annotations are advisory, batch preflight is not a transaction, secret-name filtering is incomplete, and download counts are not production adoption.

Strong alternate. Nondeveloper authoring, three described schemas, reviewed edge cases and policy-change invalidation give useful scope; inspected query and contract-health functions substantiate policy mechanics. Minted contracts add reusable intent/defaults rather than expressiveness beyond run_query. Handles remain linkable, so literal identifier removal is not anonymity. Competitor counts and policy-deletion ablations do not establish superiority.

Promising new alternate, moderated from the broad first pass. Evidence-controlled registration, stale withdrawal and must-kill mutants are substantive. The shipped adapter is Ledgerly, while broader adapters and CI remain future work. Killing a designated mutant demonstrates sensitivity to that fault, not universal correctness or independent assurance; minimization is not proof of a globally smallest safe interface.

Strong engineering, outside the final ten on current scope. Multiplayer state, scoped workers, leases and immutable review are concrete. Today's workers create canvas artifacts, not repository implementations; worktrees, captured tests and repository integration approval are future work. Reachable links are not verified implementation, and a macOS runner plus authenticated local clients increases onboarding cost.

Distinctive nested tools and generated applications, but the delivered local shell is just-bash. Network/language execution is opt-in cloud work and remote browsing uses Chrome elsewhere; publishing is text-only. It is a bounded workspace rather than a general local computer, and remote browsing/publication authority is less fully specified than its local lifecycle.

Useful bounded model checking, but Interleave provides a more concrete applied regression workflow. Inspected source evaluates violations at terminal states despite broader every-reached-state language. Automatic models can miss semantics; zero findings is bounded to the model, and repair is a constrained version guard rather than arbitrary synthesis.

Interesting feasibility and compensating-hold workflow across providers. However, release requests can fail, so the described mechanisms do not establish that nothing can ever remain booked. Typed filtering reduces injection channels without establishing truthful providers. Real agency governance, availability and adoption remain untested; a fallback transport makes absolute WebMCP-exclusivity claims too strong.

A strong disclosure-control experiment, not a verified tenancy service. Revocation cannot retract answers already exposed, colluding origins and repeated sessions defeat the stated budget, and browser-held predicates do not authenticate documents or income. Its explicit caveats improve credibility without solving those practical impact limits.

Substantial source-level downgrade from the description-only assessment. The authorization endpoint stores caller-supplied records whose schema permits AUTHORIZED without a passkey assertion; the inspected verifier checks status/digest/expiry but not the assertion. This undermines the mandatory exact-action passkey guarantee in the saved snapshot. It is not a live exploit finding; deployment restrictions or later fixes could change exposure. See QUALITY-AUDIT.md.
